faq.q: How do I install Chess.com on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Chess.com and check the developer is Chess.com before tapping Install. Google Play only shows the Install button if your phone is compatible. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Chess.com and may be altered, so the safest way to play Chess.com is the official listing.
Yes. You can play unlimited games, solve daily puzzles and play bots for free. Memberships unlock unlimited puzzles, lessons and full game reviews.

faq.q: Can beginners learn chess with Chess.com?
faq.a: Yes. The app teaches the rules, has lessons and beginner bots, and Game Review explains your mistakes after each game.
It's rated Everyone. Chess.com has a kids' mode on chesskid.com and settings to limit chat and messages. Turn chat off for young children.
